Лёд, вода и пар состоят из одинаковых мо: Ice, water and steam are made of the same molecules. They differ in how the molecules are arranged and how they move.
Одно и то же вещество может быть твёрдым: The same substance can be solid, liquid or gas. In a solid the molecules are arranged in a strict order and only vibrate around their places. In a liquid the molecules are close to each other but jump from place to place — that is why a liquid flows. In a gas the distances between molecules are much larger than the molecules themselves; the molecules move fast and fill the whole container.

Как удлинение пружины зависит от растяги: How does the extension of a spring depend on the force stretching it?

Когда рычаг находится в равновесии?: When is a lever in balance?
Когда силы обратно пропорциональны плеча: When the forces are inversely proportional to the arms: F₁ / F₂ = l₂ / l₁
Когда силы, действующие на рычаг, равны: When the forces acting on the lever are equal
Когда плечи сил равны: When the arms of the forces are equal
Рычаг находится в равновесии, когда силы: A lever is in balance when the forces are inversely proportional to their arms: F₁ / F₂ = l₂ / l₁. In other words, the moments of the forces are equal: F₁ · l₁ = F₂ · l₂. A smaller force balances a larger one if its arm is longer.
